meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过二维码或配对码直连 WhatsApp 频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中直接连接 WhatsApp 发送或接收消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel via QR code or pairing code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to directly connect WhatsApp in your app to send or receive messages.

howto.what: 为 NanoClaw 装上 WhatsApp 通道，通过 Baileys 适配器直连 WhatsApp Web。用二维码或配对码认证后，WhatsApp 成为可用消息通道；还能设置助理用专用号还是个人号。
howto.when: 当你说“添加 WhatsApp”“接入 WhatsApp”等要求时触发；会先询问用专用号还是个人号。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 添加 WhatsApp 通道。
用配对码连接我的 WhatsApp。
我把个人号码设为 shared 模式。

howto.what_en: Adds WhatsApp to NanoClaw via the native Baileys adapter—a direct WhatsApp Web connection. After QR or pairing-code auth, WhatsApp works as a channel. Also sets dedicated vs personal number mode and writes .env.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add WhatsApp support, e.g. saying 'add WhatsApp'. Includes a required number-safety check before install/auth.

say_en.text: Link my WhatsApp with a pairing code.
Set my personal number to shared mode.
say_en.note: Shows risk warning and asks confirmation.
